_note: Phase 212 Eureka Grounding Guard closed enum registry. Follows the dispatch-framework-map.json precedent (a closed lookup table read rather than reinvented) and Canon Part 9 typed-packet discipline (enums crossing the Brain boundary are stable and versioned, never free-form strings that drift). verdicts is the four-class critic output enum; reasoning_tags is the closed one-line-explanation enum that replaces free-text reasoning across the MCP boundary (D2); domain_tags is the generic source/target domain enum for the D1 wire payload and NEVER carries room artifact vocabulary. Bump schema_version on any change and recalibrate.

reasoning_tags.unsourced_quantity: Candidate carries an unsourced K/M/B or dollar figure; routes to pseudoscience before any LLM call.
reasoning_tags.domain_swap_invariant: Mechanism embedding barely moves under noun-swap; generic filler, not a real transfer.
reasoning_tags.low_novelty_delta: Nearest neighbor in the user graph is near-identical; a restatement, not a new salient.
reasoning_tags.entity_nonspecific: Too few specific entities named in the mechanism; vague, not checkable.
reasoning_tags.rubric_disagreement: Neutral and adversarial rubric passes disagreed; routes to general_shallow rather than a coin flip.
reasoning_tags.restatement_vocab_swap: Same idea with vocabulary swapped; high differential is necessary but not sufficient.
reasoning_tags.no_checkable_consequence: The stated mechanism yields no consequence a reader could check.
reasoning_tags.schema_orphan: The shared relational schema has orphan elements with no one-to-one mapping.
reasoning_tags.passes_all_gates: Cleared every Stage A gate and the rubric; a candidate transferable salient.
reasoning_tags.calibration_unknown: The rubric pattern is unseen on the gold set or the encoder was unavailable; route to human review.
